title: Beurre blanc
notes: Holds warm in the bowl for up to 20 min, TM7: 20 min / 60 °C / speed 1. Never let it overheat or boil.

steps.text: Put {shallot} in the bowl and chop, then scrape down. TM7: 5 sec / speed 6
Add {wine} and {vinegar}. Cook until reduced to a few spoonfuls of syrupy liquid. TM7: 12 min / 100 °C / speed 1
Let the reduction cool slightly in the bowl, so the sauce does not split.
Add {butter} in 8 batches, running the machine after each batch. Repeat until all the butter is fully emulsified and the sauce is glossy. TM7: 10 sec / 70 °C / speed 3
If the sauce looks thin, cook a little longer. If too thick, stop, add a splash of cold water, resume. TM7: 1 min / 70 °C / speed 3
Optional: add {tarragon} and mix in. TM7: 5 sec / speed 2
Season to taste with salt and white pepper. Serve immediately.
